text:
anya: Heads-up — after kv-prefetch PR we’re seeing comm/compute overlap disappear on multi-GPU. tp=2 runs p50 latency doubled for short seq (32). allreduce seems to wait for host sync during CUDA graph replay. Repro on bench-cluster-5.
kevin: Can you paste a profiler trace / nsys output? also which kernel_selector change landed?
anya: quick nsys snippet below (trimmed):
```
CUDA Graph Replay: host_sync at 0x7f... wait 2.1ms
AllReduce(NCCL) queued on stream 2 (capture-stream)
AttentionFusedKernel launched on stream 5 (external-stream) -> emits host sync before capture replay
```
kevin: ah that looks like cross-stream submission. if a kernel is enqueued on an external stream during capture, graph replay can serialize with host sync.
maria: PR 3456 changed aw_kernel_selector to prefer fused-attn when seq<=64. fused-attn uses a different stream for async prefetch to L2. I flagged potential capture interaction but thought we had a guard.
sam: confirmed commit 9c7a2f8 moved kv-prefetch -> async_stream for latency reasons (benchmarks for single-GPU improved). missed multi-gpu cudaGraph path.
perf-bot: CI perf/regression: bench/multi-gpu/short-seq increased 1.9x — https://ci/redwood/98765
kevin: quick triage plan: 1) try forcing fused-attn to use capture stream (fallback) 2) reproduce with gdb/nvtx to see host sync source 3) consider reverting selector. can someone bisect the change?
anya: did a quick experiment: forcing kv-prefetch to capture-stream (env KV_PREFETCH_STREAM=internal) restores overlap and reduces p50 back ~1.0x. so workaround works for now.
maria: thanks — I'll draft a hotfix to make fused-attn stream choice capture-aware during capture/graph mode. putting up a patch that checks in_cuda_graph_context().
kevin: also add a regression test: wrap a small graph capture with tp/pipeline and verify no host sync edges between streams.
deploy-bot: I've queued a canary revert (build 2026-11-03-9c7a2f8 -> 2026-10-29) on bench-cluster-5 for further validation. :eyes:
anya: running 6h load with KV_PREFETCH_STREAM=internal, will report results. if stable we can ship opt+guard. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
